correctness.rationale: Jiang definitions imply precisely three one-bond interleavings; exactly one leaves rotations, weighted 1/3 under B and 1 under I, for both packet choices and every gap. This gives a positive all-n off-H measure and exact triple of first-order projected generators. The no-break rotation walk is primitive; its finite-state spectral gap justifies singular perturbation. A supported (n-1)-cycle and the n-cycle generate S_n; the resulting quotient CTMC is irreducible and has a strictly decreasing TV profile. Two-point profile brackets prove both q-mixing limits. The embedded exact checker independently reconstructs coefficients n=4..8 and quotient generators n=5,6 without substituting enumeration for the proof.

value.rationale: Full-deck mixing of adhesive riffles is a motivated stochastic problem. The order-only strong-adhesion theorem leaves its exact constants and time profiles unspecified; proving identical quotient dynamics up to exactly a factor of three for all n simultaneously yields a structural and sharp comparison for two genuinely different block-release mechanisms, extending beyond a prior small-deck instance. The result is not a generic theorem of finite-state perturbation alone because it requires a nontrivial combinatorial all-one-break classification.
